description: project_members.addProjectMember (POST /v1/projects/{idOrName}/members): the live API returns 404 `not_found` ("Project not found.") when the target project no longer exists (probed 2026-08-13), but the spec declares no 404 — add it so a vanished host project surfaces as a typed NotFound instead of the catch-all. (Role-combination rejections like `invalid_team_and_project_role_combination` and unknown-uid `not_a_member` arrive as declared 400s and are already typed BadRequest.)
